scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,expo -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:expo"
scripts.dev:api: bash scripts/free-api-port.sh && bash -c 'cd backend && exec ../.venv/bin/python -m uvicorn server:app --host "${BACKEND_HOST:-0.0.0.0}" --port "${BACKEND_PORT:-8001}" --reload'
scripts.dev:expo: bash -c 'cd frontend && exec npx expo start'
scripts.dev:web: bash scripts/ensure-dev-env.sh && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:expo:web"
scripts.dev:expo:web: bash -c 'cd frontend && exec npx expo start --web'
scripts.dev:ios: bash scripts/ensure-dev-env.sh && concurrently -k -n api,ios -c blue,cyan "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:expo:ios"
scripts.dev:expo:ios: bash -c 'cd frontend && exec npx expo run:ios'
scripts.dev:ios:metro: bash scripts/ensure-dev-env.sh && concurrently -k -n api,ios -c blue,cyan "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:expo:ios:metro"
scripts.dev:expo:ios:metro: bash -c 'cd frontend && exec npx expo start --ios'
scripts.dev:expo:android: bash -c 'source scripts/android-env.sh; cd frontend && exec npx expo run:android'
scripts.dev:expo:android:metro: bash -c 'cd frontend && exec npx expo start --android'
scripts.native:ios: bash scripts/ensure-dev-env.sh && bash -c 'cd frontend && exec npx expo run:ios'
